resources.string: Based on GrapheneOS privacy and security, with some extras.
Let\'s set up your device in a few steps.
Let\'s set up your user profile in a few steps.
Allow apps that have asked your permission to use your location information. This may include your current location and past locations.

Enable network location to determine your location better (such as when indoors) and more efficiently. Nearby wireless signal identifiers will be sent to an Apple server through a GrapheneOS proxy only when network location is being used.

Allow apps and services with permission to scan for Wi-Fi networks to do so even when Wi-Fi is off. For example, when network location is on, this allows it to scan for Wi-Fi networks even when Wi-Fi is off, improving location accuracy.

Enable geocoder to allow apps to use a network-based service hosted by GrapheneOS to convert between geographic coordinates and human-readable addresses. Some apps need this for critical functionality.

Encrypts your device\'s domain name lookups with DNS-over-TLS and blocks ads and trackers. Networks and your ISP cannot see or tamper with the sites you visit, but they can still see the IP addresses you connect to.

This release of MosaicOS is in beta. This means that while initial, simple testing has not revealed any issues, extensive testing has not been conducted. Bugs, crashes, and unexpected behavior may occur.

This is intended for those who want to stay up to date and participate in testing new features. It is by no means 100% stable. 

Please keep this in mind and use the system accordingly.
Blocks USB and wireless debugging on this device for good. Only a factory reset can undo it.

USB debugging and wireless debugging will be switched off and locked. The switches in Developer options stay visible but can no longer be turned on.
This cannot be undone by any setting, app or command. The only way to use ADB on this device again is to erase all data with a factory reset.
